title: Give two facts only you hold, or let us record them as 'not supplied'?
bluf: Two plan rows need facts only you have: the named Product Owner and a deputy for absences (SOW 7.3), and the baseline hours a manual assessment takes (the main KPI has no baseline). We will not invent either. Option B records both as 'not supplied, placeholder' so the weekly report and metrics carry a visible gap rather than a guess. Default if you do not tap: option B, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-6, HPSMPOC-51

options.label: I will reply with the names and the baseline hours
options.detail: Send them when ready; Tuesday records them with source.

default_action: Option B: record both as not supplied, labelled placeholders.
